overview: Latts Razzi is a theelin bounty hunter from Unknown, documented across Clone Wars. Theelin hunter in young Boba Fett's Clone Wars crew alongside Bossk and Aurra Sing.

Latts Razzi, a Theelin hunter, joined young Boba Fett's Clone Wars crew bringing starship piloting and underworld connections alongside Bossk's strength and Aurra Sing's sniper work. Coverage spans all nine saga films, Clone Wars, Rebels, Mandalorian, Book of Boba Fett, Andor, KOTOR, KOTOR II, SWTOR, and Sith Empire-era mercenary markets.

Latts flew Boba's crew missions during revenge operations against Jedi, navigated Separatist-adjacent space, and survived internal crew violence when Aurra eliminated weak links. Jedi, Sith, and clone troopers alike learned to respect or fear Latts Razzi's approach to pursuit and extraction.
